messages:
sam: Hey team — ran into a reproducible hang in the Go SDK generator sample when auth refresh happens mid-stream. Short TTL token + retry/backoff -> caller cancels ctx but internal retry goroutine keeps running and the caller blocks on a channel range. Anyone else?

katie: Yep, reproduced. Sample spawns a retry goroutine that uses context.Background(), so cancellation doesn't reach it. We get goroutine leaks and a deadlocked reader.

sam: Minimal snippet I used:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(req.Context(), 4*time.Second)
defer cancel()
g := sdk.NewGenerator(c)
stream := g.Start(ctx, req) // opaque helper that returns Events() chan
for ev := range stream.Events() { fmt.Print(ev.Text) }
```
If token refresh triggers a retry, Events() isn't closed and the loop never ends.

leo: Two-pronged fix: (1) change sample to avoid context.Background() in goroutines, (2) improve SDK ergonomics so streaming is explicit about lifecycle.

katie: Proposed API: keep Start/Events for compatibility but add Stream(ctx, req) -> (*GeneratorStream, error). GeneratorStream methods: Recv(ctx) (Chunk, error), Close() error, Done() <-chan struct{}. That forces callers to propagate ctx and makes cancellation deterministic.

sam: Example pattern to show in sampleapp:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(reqCtx, 10*time.Second)
defer cancel()
str, err := gen.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
defer str.Close()
for {
 ch, err := str.Recv(ctx)
 if err == io.EOF { break }
 if err != nil { return err }
 fmt.Print(ch.Text)
}
```
This ensures Recv returns quickly on ctx cancel.

leo: Also add CI e2e that simulates a short TTL + forced refresh mid-stream and checks for no leaked goroutines after Close. Small lint/CI check could flag `context.Background()` in long-lived goroutines in sample repos.

katie: I'll open a PR with the sample changes, the small API shim, and the e2e. Tagging for next devex sprint and will add a changelog blurb.

bot-ci: Created ticket SDK-1502: "Go SDK generator: explicit stream lifecycle & auth-refresh robustness" and added to backlog.
